verdict.rationale: a-Shell provides its own WASI-sdk for cross-compiling programs into WebAssembly commands, and a pkg mechanism for installing precompiled commands. That is an official SDK for building against the app. There is no evidence of official client SDKs or a programmatic API for driving a-Shell from code or agents: the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both return 404, and automation is limited to Apple Shortcuts. Missing for 10: official language SDKs or API for programmatic or agent integration, SDK documentation depth, independent corroboration of SDK usage.
